sprints.name: gym-full Sprint 1
sprints.goal: Members can see the gym's monthly, quarterly and yearly plans with their prices.

sprints.name: gym-full Sprint 2
sprints.goal: Members can sign in with their phone number and a WhatsApp code and see their plan and membership status.

sprints.name: gym-full Sprint 3
sprints.goal: New members can sign up on their phone with a confirmed phone number, and each member sees their own QR code.

sprints.name: gym-full Sprint 4
sprints.goal: Members can pay online with UPI or card and renew from their own page, with the membership starting only once payment is confirmed.

sprints.name: gym-full Sprint 5
sprints.goal: Front-desk staff can check in an existing member by phone number, with the existing members loaded from the Excel sheet.

sprints.name: gym-full Sprint 6
sprints.goal: Front-desk staff can check members in by scanning their QR code and are warned when a membership has expired.

sprints.name: gym-full Sprint 7
sprints.goal: Front-desk staff can record a cash payment that extends a member's membership.

sprints.name: gym-full Sprint 8
sprints.goal: Members are asked for WhatsApp consent, including existing members at first sign-in, so that they can receive messages they have accepted.

sprints.name: gym-full Sprint 9
sprints.goal: Members get a WhatsApp reminder 7 days before their membership expires, sent only to eligible members.

sprints.name: gym-full Sprint 10
sprints.goal: New members can start a 7-day free trial and then pay online to become members when it ends.

assumptions: Cold start: fewer than 3 closed sprints with history; capacity = person-hours ÷ 6.0 h/SP × 0.7 (low confidence).
20% of capacity reserved for maintenance work.
Priority follows the approved roadmap: release (MVP → R2 → R3), then MoSCoW, then the tracker's Rank.
summary_md:
- Sprint 1 (23 Nov–6 Dec) delivers the data foundation (home branch and check-ins, roles, staff accounts, English text) and lets members see the plans and prices. It commits 15 points against 15.7 expected capacity, which is above the 85% level (12.5).
- MVP is late: it is due 31 Dec 2026 but is planned to finish 28 Feb 2027 (sprint 7), with a 50% forecast of 14 Mar and 85% of 28 Mar. The due date is not hard.
- R2 is incomplete: GT-57 and GT-58 are deferred, and the sprints run to sprint 10 (50% forecast 9 May, 85% forecast 23 May). R3 is incomplete: all 7 of its stories are deferred, with a forecast of 6 Jun 2027.
- Risks: capacity confidence is low because there is no velocity history (fewer than 3 closed sprints). Sprints 1 to 6, 8 and 9 are committed above their 85% capacity levels. 20% of capacity is reserved for maintenance.
- Needed from the approver: accept the late MVP date or move the 31 Dec due date, and confirm that deferring GT-57 and GT-58 from R2 and the R3 stories is acceptable. Sprint goals for sprints 7 and 8 are now each one outcome as requested.
